author: UncondemnedSinner
body:
I've been tethering since Day one.  My wife was the only person in the world who ever calls me, so there was never any purpose in me adding internet to my phone.

After a month of borrowing her phone to tether so I could play.... she finally broke down and got me unlimited access.   Since I don't play on my phone, but rather on my 10" Asus Zenpad 3s..... I'm still tethering, even today.

Just remember that you will really need an unlimited plan if you intend to play.  I've run up over 46 DAYS WORTH of game time since I started.   That's a lot of tethering and the phone company constantly complains to me about it.  ROFL.   I just remind them ----- you said "Unlimited".
